claim: New raw RPT and Cycling signals improve development MAE, with capacity controls and explicit reliability tradeoffs.
scope: C3 same-condition new cells, one seed, no independent confirmation. 61 observed-event cells for MAE; 62 cells for event metrics.
uncertainty: 4000 physical-cell percentile bootstrap draws seed20261021. c averages three arms within cell first. d aggregates repeated same-history pairs within cell first. a/b descriptive aggregates, no seed CI.
counterfactual_limits: Cycle availability assumed at source completion because transmission times absent. Shape normalized by matching arrived leg capacity. VI/time panel removes six Q/throughput variables but retains observed cycle count.
